question.problem: Which of the following is equivalent to $\frac{18x-6}{3}?$
question.worked_solution:
Splitting the fraction into separate terms and then simplifying the fractions in individual terms, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{18x-6}{3} & = \\ \frac{18x}{3}-\frac{6}{3} & = \\ \frac{18}{3}\cdot x-\frac{6}{3} & = \\ 6\cdot x-2 & = \\ 6x-2. & \end{aligned}
$$
